summary: Rivian Automotive filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to an existing DOE loan facility. On April 30, 2026, Rivian New Horizon LLC and Rivian Automotive entered into an amended loan agreement with the US Department of Energy, restructuring a multi-draw term loan into two tranches: up to $3.355 billion (15-year) and $650.9 million (10-year), plus capitalized interest. Proceeds fund Phase 1 of a Georgia EV manufacturing plant. No price per share, premium, board recommendation, or change of control is involved. This is a financing amendment, not a special situation. What to watch: draw conditions include positive gross margin and vehicle sales milestones.
